layers.message: Record scope, design, and plan for text helper move

graderOnly: The scope and the technical design are complete and consistent; DEV-001 needs no upstream change.
tests/unit/test_digest.py exercises app/reports/digest.py only through build_digest and never imports app/utils/text.py, so it passes unchanged after the move.

FastAPI, Pydantic, and uv are not installed and package registries are blocked, so app/main.py and the routers cannot be imported; the moved helpers and their two callers use only the standard library.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Pre-install layers 50-52 build digest-api in three commits: 50 the FastAPI service (app/main.py, app/routers/health.py and items.py, app/services/items.py, app/schemas.py, app/core/__init__.py and config.py, pyproject, README); 51 the weekly digest (app/utils/text.py with slugify and truncate_words, app/utils/dates.py, app/reports/digest.py, tests/unit/test_digest.py); 52 scripts/export_digest.py and a README update. Only digest.py and the script import app.utils.text; no route, service, or schema does. Layer 60 commits the cycle: STATE.md (DEVELOPING, STANDARD, FULL_DELIVERABLE, Handoff FORWARD from ARCHITECTING, BlockedOn NONE, recovery inactive), Auditor CONTEXT.md, the scope with AC-001 worded as the case states, the technical design (move unchanged, update two imports, delete the old module, no route/schema/persistence/setup change), and the development plan (APPROVED, AUTONOMOUS, User Style NONE locked, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE, one step DEV-001 PENDING with Acceptance AC-001). Tests import only standard-library code, so python3 -m pytest passes without FastAPI; FastAPI and uv are absent and registries blocked (selfChecks prove each).
